positive: Write the spec, get the plan approved by an independent check, and bind the implementation back to it as one resumable linked record
Reconcile two divergent drafts of the same plan and check whether the contract is approved before any mutation happens
near_negative: Create a new skill after a repeated capability gap has been proven at least twice
Review this pull request's code changes for bugs
Write a one-off design note with nobody asked to sign off on it

behavior_assertions.assert: The shipped skill's own bundle validates: scope, delivery, safety, and no orphaned or dead-linked file.
planmode specify refuses a spec missing any of its four required fields rather than starting incomplete.

behavior_assertions: planmode check reports mutation is not allowed and names the missing contract fields when no plan has been approved (proven on an isolated fixture in tests/test_godmode_spec_lifecycle.py, never against ambient project-wide plan state).
planmode approve refuses an incomplete contract and names its exact missing fields rather than waiving them.
planmode bind names every file outside a plan's declared scope as drift rather than allowing it silently.
